name: Aquazzura
band_note: shoe house, banded on shoe entry $790 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's heels, sandals, boots and evening bags handmade in Italy, shoes mostly $900–$1,850, sold through its own boutiques, site and department stores.
origin: Founded in Florence, Italy in 2011 by Edgardo Osorio.

ownership.owner: Aquazzura Italia S.r.l. (operating company per site footer; shareholders not published)

quote.q: For me, it’s not about creating sculptures or architecture — it’s simply about making women look beautiful.
quote.who: Edgardo Osorio, founder and creative director

opview: “For me, it’s not about creating sculptures or architecture — it’s simply about making women look beautiful.” — Edgardo Osorio, founder and creative director, The Designer, aquazzura.com

facts_read.source: brand site; La Conceria 2020-01-16; neimanmarcus.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

doors.note: US: 2 own doors, both labelled 'Flagship Store' — New York, 939 Madison Ave, and Miami, 9700 Collins Ave #131, Bal Harbour FL. The New York entry shows 'Seasonally Closed' where the opening hours usually sit; counted, status open, flagged. No ZIPs on the page. World: 28 entries — 18 'Flagship Store' and 10 'Shop in Shop' (La Rinascente, Le Bon Marché, Galeries Lafayette Paris and Dubai, El Corte Inglés x3, Madrid Serrano, Jeddah, Jakarta); none of the shop-in-shops is in the US. No stockist list. Florence label.

craft_evidence.owned: no — 'Tuscan shoemaking workshops' described but not named or claimed as owned; HQ Palazzo Corsini, Florence
craft_evidence.mills: no — PDP gives material by type (e.g. 'SUEDE LEATHER')
craft_evidence.madein: PDP template has a 'Made in:' field (ITALY on the one PDP opened); the field loads on click so a wider sample was not re
craft_evidence.heritage: placed, not dated on the pages read — headquarters in Palazzo Corsini, Florence
craft_evidence.process: partial — pattern makers, a mould per style, up to 30 hand-assembled components, up to six months per style, final hand check
craft_evidence.reasoning: The craftsmanship page describes the making steps (pattern, mould, up to 30 hand-assembled components) and places it in Tuscan workshops, and product pages carry a Made-in field. No workshop is named or shown as owned. That is a strong 2; a named workshop would make it a 3.
